about: The collecta of the formulary “Christ the King” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Almighty everlasting God, who in Your beloved Son, King of the universe, willed to renew all things, graciously grant that all the families of the nations, torn apart by the wound of sin, be brought under the most gentle rule of Him, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
